site.name: Columbia Animal Hospital
site.tagline: A full-service companion animal hospital in Columbia, Mississippi.

hours.summary: Mon–Fri 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM · Sat 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM · Sun closed

emergency.headline: After-hours emergencies
emergency.policy: An on-call veterinarian is available after hours in the case of an emergency.
emergency.notice: Columbia Animal Hospital is not a 24-hour emergency hospital. Outside our posted hours, an on-call veterinarian is available for emergencies — call the hospital and follow the instructions you are given.

copy.heroHeadline: Compassionate care for every stage of their life
copy.closerHeadline: Your pet deserves compassionate, experienced care.
copy.mission: To provide professional, compassionate veterinary care to clients and their furry family members.
